:::{#rem-mutually-exclusive}
#### Mutually exclusive events

In probability, [pairwise disjoint](#def-pairwise-disjoint)
[events](#def-probability-measure) are usually called **mutually exclusive**.
For example, for one roll of a six-sided die,
the events "the roll is [even](notation.qmd#def-even-odd)", $\set{2, 4, 6}$,
and "the roll is odd", $\set{1, 3, 5}$,
are mutually exclusive:
no roll is both even and odd.

:::
